newsitem.title: UK: Barclays at record as Laing repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Barclays at record as Laing repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc reached a record high in early trading on Tuesday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
The stock was up 16p at 10.38-1/2 stg by 0855 GMT after earlier reaching a record 10.42 stg -- surpassing its previous high of 10.38 stg set December 5.
Analysts at Laing confirmed they continued to rate Barclays as a "buy" but declined further comment.
Other bank stocks also extended yesterday's rebound as the UK market rallied from Friday's sharp drop, with Lloyds TSB Plc up 10-1/2p at 426 and National Westminster Bank Plc up 5p at 674-1/2.
